title: Saw sharper UAP video on the inside than released footage

tellings.quote: I've definitely been exposed to a mix of quality both in terms of the visual fidelity and in the resolution of what this object is.

plain: A Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown says that inside the government he saw videos of unidentified flying objects that ranged in quality, some sharper and clearer about what the object was than the footage released to the public. He tells Michels this from his own work around 2018, and it would mean the public has seen only the blurrier end of what exists.
